clothing_prompt: Create ONE production-ready transparent game AVATAR CLOTHING LAYER only: SUBJECT. This is an isolated front-facing shoulder-and-upper-chest garment with an EMPTY TRANSPARENT NECK OPENING. Absolutely no head, no neck skin, no mannequin, no person, no face, no hands. Style: polished hand-painted collectible western rustic game illustration matching dimensional realistic painted animal/human heads; rich cloth or leather texture, directional warm light, deep natural folds, seams, worn material highlights, olive/cream/bronze palette. It must look like an illustrated actual garment, not flat outlined cartoon or vector symbol. Composition: wide symmetrical cropped bust, shoulders occupy full width, upper-chest only, lower edge rounded as a bust crop. Garment visible within x5%-95%, y10%-95% of canvas. The neckline opening top-center around x40%-60%, y10%-35% is transparent so a separate head and neck can be placed above. Collars face forward and neckline must fit a separate narrow neck. No text, no background or frame. Genuine transparency. Distinct elegant collectible style, readable at small size.
headwear_prompt: Create ONE production-ready transparent game AVATAR HAT LAYER only: SUBJECT. Isolated wearable headwear viewed straight from the FRONT, symmetrical perspective with subtle dimensional depth. Absolutely no head, no face, no person, no mannequin, no hair, no clothes. Polished hand-painted collectible western rustic game illustration with realistic material texture, directional warm light, worn highlights, olive/cream/bronze palette, natural material shadows, crisp silhouette. Not a flat vector or generic cartoon icon. The hat lower brim runs horizontally so it can sit on a separate forehead. Entire hat within x5%-95%, y10%-90%, ample transparent margin, compact wide composition. Shape complete, no cropped edges. No text, no background or decorative frame. Genuine alpha transparency.
hair_and_face_prompt: Create ONE transparent game avatar wearable component ONLY: SUBJECT. Isolated HAIR accessory, absolutely no head, face, skin, neck, eyes, ears, mannequin, clothes or shoulders. Straight-on front view for compositing over an independent avatar face, symmetrical presentation except the described hairstyle. Polished hand-painted rustic collectible game art matching realistic painted heads, fine natural hair strands, dimensional subtle sheen, earthy western styling. NO flat vector look, NO broad outlines. Entire accessory visible with transparent padding; leave the empty face region genuine transparent. No text or numbers. No glow, backdrop, floating drop shadow or background shape. Transparency around and through the opening. Rich detailed but readable at small size.
